decisions.reason: Existing authorized technical verification can proceed within its agreed scope; report observations without claiming semantic truth or adoption.
Technical lesson validation and revocation within existing authorized scope are technical lifecycle work, not a new value choice.
Publishing private role memory outside its authorized scope changes permission and requires an explicit human decision; it is not authorized here.

remaining: Run a bounded, pre-specified memory transfer comparison with relevant controls, independently check outcomes, and preserve failures; do not infer causality from retrieval alone.
Measure model and human time and total costs directly before making efficiency claims.
Expertise discovery, routing, and answer quality have not been implemented or demonstrated; define authorized scope before any sharing experiment.
No general natural-language planning or expert-routing runtime is deployed; verify only the documented local scripts and stored artifacts.
